summary: Select Water Solutions' subsidiary executed a September 24, 2026 Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire all outstanding membership interests in Pilot Water Solutions LLC, funded partly by a new $500 million senior secured revolver struck October 13, 2026, with a $50 million letter of credit sublimit. The facility activates only upon closing the acquisition, matures five years after effectiveness, and permits $250 million of additional commitments. Purchase price, premium and advisor details were not disclosed in the excerpt. Watch acquisition completion conditions, commitment termination risk, and leverage overhang.
